summary.text: Rodney Creech is a Republican state representative from Ohio who has represented District 40 since January 1, 2023, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A farmer and business owner, he earned a bachelor's degree in agronomy from Morehead State University.

paragraphs.text: Rodney Creech was born in West Alexandria, Ohio, and earned a bachelor's degree in agronomy from Morehead State University, according to Ballotpedia.
His career experience includes working as a farmer and owning a business.
Ballotpedia lists Creech's tenure in the Ohio House of Representatives as beginning in 2021, with his current District 40 term starting January 1, 2023.
In the 2021-2022 session he was vice chair of the Agriculture and Conservation Committee.
He advanced from the Republican primary for the Ohio House on May 5, 2026.
